## Common words

- [傘](../words/傘.md) かさ — umbrella; parasol
- 日傘 ひがさ — parasol; sunshade
- 雨傘 あまがさ — rain umbrella
- 傘下 さんか — affiliated with; under an organization's umbrella

comparisons.reason: JMdict 1301940 sense 2 is "something shaped like an umbrella or a conical hat; mushroom cap" (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:21-27)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared on either card: 帽 is a hat or head covering (repo/kanji/帽.md:20); Daijisen defines 傘 as held over the head and distinct from the head-worn 笠 (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:6); sense 2 names umbrella-shaped objects, not headgear

comparisons.reason: KANJIDIC2 lists "shade" for 暗; 傘 sense 2 has "shade (of a lamp)"
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: 暗 teaches darkness or lack of light (repo/kanji/暗.md:20-21); 傘's shade is a physical lampshade object (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:25), as 傘.md:47 says

comparisons.reason: A sunshade casts shade; 日傘 is glossed "sunshade"
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: 影's senses are shadow, silhouette, image, light and trace (repo/kanji/影.md:23); no 傘 sense names a shadow (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:16-27)

comparisons.reason: KANJIDIC2 lists "cover" for 包; an umbrella covers from above
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: 包 teaches wrapping, enclosing, parcels and encirclement (repo/kanji/包.md:20); 傘 is a held overhead object, not an act of wrapping or enclosing (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:6)
Harmless, not declared: 灯 names the light or lamp itself (repo/kanji/灯.md:20); 傘 names only the shade part (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:25), not the light

comparisons.reason: An umbrella protects against rain or sun
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: 防 is protection or prevention as an action (repo/kanji/防.md:20); 傘 names the object (snapshot/words/傘.md:29); shared function is only shared subject matter
Harmless, not declared: 守 means guarding or keeping rules (repo/kanji/守.md:20); no 傘 dictionary sense means guard (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:16-27)
Harmless, not declared: 保 means protecting, preserving or maintaining a state (repo/kanji/保.md:22); 傘 is a concrete umbrella object (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:53)

comparisons.reason: Overhead shelter; KANJIDIC2 gives 宇 roof and eaves
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: 宇's senses are eaves, roof, house, heaven and space (repo/kanji/宇.md:20); 傘 is a hand-held umbrella, not a building part (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:6)
Harmless, not declared: 軒 names building eaves and is a counter for buildings (repo/kanji/軒.md:20); no umbrella sense
Harmless, not declared: 屋 covers buildings, roofs and shops (repo/kanji/屋.md:20); a held umbrella is not a roof (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:6)

comparisons.reason: 傘下 is glossed "under jurisdiction of" (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:43-61)
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: the jurisdiction sense belongs to the whole compound with 下, and Daijisen gives 傘 in 傘下 the sense かさ (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:14); 領 is territory or jurisdiction (repo/kanji/領.md:20)

comparisons.reason: 傘下 "affiliated with" overlaps 系列's group of affiliated businesses
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: the affiliation sense is compound-level (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:43-61), and 系's senses are lineage, system, group and type (repo/kanji/系.md:23-31). 系's own exclusion of distractor 全 is a different pair and is not transitive

comparisons.reason: からかさ is a bamboo-and-oiled-paper umbrella
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: material only; 竹 names bamboo (repo/kanji/竹.md:20), and 傘 does not mean bamboo (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:16-27)

comparisons.reason: からかさ is a paper umbrella
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: material only; 紙 means paper (repo/kanji/紙.md:20)
Harmless, not declared: 雨 is rain itself (repo/kanji/雨.md:20); the word article says 傘 names the protective object, not the rain (snapshot/words/傘.md:29)

comparisons.reason: 日傘 (parasol, sunshade) protects against the sun
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, not declared: 陽 means sunlight or the sun (repo/kanji/陽.md:20); the parasol is the object, not sunshine
Harmless, not declared: material only; 布 means cloth or distribution (repo/kanji/布.md:20)

comparisons.reason: Existing direct exclusion target; KANJIDIC2 gives 被 cover, veil and shelter (evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:836-849)
comparisons.disposition: Already handled: declared on 傘 (snapshot/kanji/傘.md:14), not on 被 (repo/kanji/被.md:1-12, no quiz_exclusions). "cover" could defensibly describe an umbrella or lampshade; a conservative exclusion is justified, and one endpoint is enough
